```{r}
# ============================================================================

# データファイルを読み込む共通関数
load_endes_data <- function(year, filename, keep_vars) {
  cat("Loading:", filename, "\n")
  cat("Variables to keep:", paste(keep_vars, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  
  df <- open_endes_file(year, filename) %>%
    rename_with(~ tolower(.x)) %>%
    add_missing_columns(keep_vars) %>% 
    dplyr::select(all_of(keep_vars))
  
  return(df)
}

# 出力ディレクトリを準備する関数
setup_output_directory <- function(year) {
  output_dir <- file.path(gdrive_dir, "output", year) %>%
    normalizePath() %>%
    trimws()
  
  if (!dir_exists(output_dir)) {
    dir_create(output_dir)
  }
  
  return(output_dir)
}
```

## 4. データ処理関数

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 3. データ処理関数セクション
# ============================================================================
# 家族の子供の総数を計算
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(vctrs)   # 明示的に呼んでおくと安心
calculate_child_count_fixed2 <- function(HRdata) {
  cat("計算中: 家族の子供の総数（DHS ワイド形式）\n")
  
  # 2005: hv105$1, hv105$2, ...
  # 2012: hv105.1, hv105.2, ...
  # → どちらも拾えるように、「hv105 のあとに $ か .」というパターンで抽出
  age_cols       <- grep("^hv105[.$]", names(HRdata), value = TRUE)
  residence_cols <- grep("^hv102[.$]", names(HRdata), value = TRUE)
  
  cat("年齢変数:", length(age_cols), "個,  居住変数:", length(residence_cols), "個\n")
  
  # 1. labelled を「生の numeric」に剥がす
  suppressWarnings({
    HR_clean <- HRdata %>%
      mutate(
        hv009 = as.numeric(vec_data(hv009)),     # 世帯人数も numeric に
        across(all_of(c(age_cols, residence_cols)),
               ~ as.numeric(vec_data(.)))        # labelled → numeric（属性削除）
      )
  })
  
  # 変換の確認（例として最初の列だけ表示）
  if (length(residence_cols) > 0) {
    cat("居住変数（例:", residence_cols[1], "）変換後の分布:\n")
    print(table(HR_clean[[residence_cols[1]]], useNA = "always"))
  }
  if (length(age_cols) > 0) {
    cat("年齢変数（例:", age_cols[1], "）変換後の分布（先頭20）:\n")
    print(table(HR_clean[[age_cols[1]]], useNA = "always")[1:20])
  }
  
  # 2. ロングにしてから、行番号でフィルタ → 再ワイド
  #   names_sep = "[.$]" として、"$" と "." のどちらでも区切れるようにする
  df_long <- HR_clean %>%
    select(hhid, caseid, hv009, all_of(c(age_cols, residence_cols))) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols      = -c(hhid, caseid, hv009),
      names_to  = c("variable", "line_number"),
      names_sep = "[.$]",              # ← ここを修正（$ か . のどちらでもOK）
      values_to = "value"
    ) %>%
    mutate(line_number = as.numeric(line_number)) %>%
    filter(line_number <= hv009) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from  = variable,
      values_from = value
    )
  
  cat("hv105 非NA:", sum(!is.na(df_long$hv105)),
      " 12歳以下:", sum(df_long$hv105 <= 12, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
  cat("hv102==1 の人数:", sum(df_long$hv102 == 1, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
  
  # 3. 12歳以下かつ de jure(=hv102==1) をカウント
  child_count_core <- df_long %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(hv105),
      !is.na(hv102),
      hv105 <= 12,
      hv102 == 1               # 0=No, 1=Yes（元のラベル定義どおり）
    ) %>%
    group_by(hhid, caseid) %>%
    summarise(dm_children_under12 = n(), .groups = "drop")
  
  # 4. すべての世帯に結合し、存在しない世帯は 0
  all_households <- HRdata %>%
    select(hhid, caseid)
  
  child_count <- all_households %>%
    left_join(child_count_core, by = c("hhid", "caseid")) %>%
    mutate(dm_children_under12 = tidyr::replace_na(dm_children_under12, 0L))
  
  cat("子供の数の分布:\n")
  print(table(child_count$dm_children_under12))
  cat("合計世帯数:", nrow(child_count), "\n")
  cat("子供がいる世帯数:", sum(child_count$dm_children_under12 > 0), "\n")
  
  return(child_count)
}



# 家庭での燃料使用状況を処理
process_cooking_fuel <- function(IRdata) {
  cat("処理中: 家庭での燃料使用状況\n")
  
  cooking_fuel <- IRdata %>%
    mutate(
      dm_cooking_fuel = v161,
      dm_cooking_fuel_traditional = ifelse(dm_cooking_fuel < 7, 0, 1),
      dm_cooking_fuel_traditional = ifelse(is.na(dm_cooking_fuel_traditional), 0, dm_cooking_fuel_traditional)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(caseid, hhid, dm_cooking_fuel, dm_cooking_fuel_traditional)
  
  cat("調理燃料の分布:\n")
  print(table(cooking_fuel$dm_cooking_fuel))
  print(table(cooking_fuel$dm_cooking_fuel_traditional))
  
  return(cooking_fuel)
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 4. データ統合関数セクション
# ============================================================================

# データセットを安全に結合
safe_join_datasets <- function(base_data, join_data, by_vars, join_name) {
  cat("結合中:", join_name, "\n")
  
  # 重複チェック
  duplicate_check(base_data, by_vars, "base_data")
  duplicate_check(join_data, by_vars, join_name)
  
  # 結合実行
  result <- base_data %>%
    left_join_safe(join_data, by = by_vars)
  
  cat(sprintf("%sを結合しました\n", join_name))
  duplicate_check(result, by_vars, "結合後データ")
  
  return(result)
}


# ***************************************************************
# HRデータとIRデータをhhid_joinでマージする関数
# @title merge_HR_IR
# @param HRdata HRデータフレーム
# @param IRdata IRデータフレーム
# @return マージされたデータフレーム
# ***************************************************************
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

merge_HR_IR <- function(HRdata, IRdata) {
  
  # ステップ1: IRからhhid_joinを作成（オリジナルcaseidも保持）
  IRdata_with_hhid <- IRdata %>%
    mutate(
      hhid_join = str_trim(str_replace_all(caseid, "\\s+\\d+$", "")),
      hhid_join = str_trim(str_replace_all(hhid_join, "\\s+", " "))
    )
  
  cat("ステップ1完了")
  # ステップ2: HRでhhid_joinを作成（オリジナルは保持）
  HRdata_with_join <- HRdata %>%
    mutate(
      hhid_join = str_trim(str_replace_all(hhid, "\\s+", " "))
    )
  
  cat("ステップ2完了")
  # ステップ4: hhid_joinでマッチング
  matched_data <- inner_join(
    IRdata_with_hhid,
    HRdata_with_join,
    by = "hhid_join",
    suffix = c("", ".y")   # df2 側に .y を付ける
  ) %>%
    # 不要な重複列を削除
    select(-ends_with(".y"))

  
  # ステップ5: マッチ結果
  cat("\n=== マッチング結果 ===\n")
  cat("マッチ成功（行数）:", nrow(matched_data), "\n")
  cat("マッチ成功（ユニークhhid_join数）:", n_distinct(matched_data$hhid_join), "\n")
  
  # ステップ6: オリジナルIDが保持されていることを確認
  cat("\nIRのオリジナルcaseidが存在:", all(!is.na(matched_data$caseid)), "\n")
  cat("HRのオリジナルhhidが存在:", all(!is.na(matched_data$hhid)), "\n")
  
  # # ステップ7: マッチしなかったケースの確認
  # ir_only <- anti_join(IRdata_with_hhid, HRdata_with_join, by = "hhid_join")
  # hr_only <- anti_join(HRdata_with_join, IRdata_with_hhid, by = "hhid_join")
  # 
  # cat("\n=== マッチ失敗ケース ===\n")
  # cat("IRのみ（マッチ失敗）:", nrow(ir_only), "\n")
  # cat("IRのみ（ユニークhhid_join数）:", n_distinct(ir_only$hhid_join), "\n")
  # cat("HRのみ（マッチ失敗）:", nrow(hr_only), "\n")
  # cat("HRのみ（ユニークhhid_join数）:", n_distinct(hr_only$hhid_join), "\n")
  
  # ステップ8: 世帯内の複数女性の確認
  # cat("\n=== 世帯内の複数女性分布 ===\n")
  # matched_data %>%
  #   group_by(hhid_join) %>%
  #   summarise(n_women = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  #   group_by(n_women) %>%
  #   summarise(n_households = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  #   arrange(n_women) %>%
  #   print()
  
  return(matched_data)
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 5. 変数作成関数セクション（修正版）
# ============================================================================

# 人口統計学的変数を作成（修正版）
create_demographic_variables <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    # rename(
    #   v001 = hv001,  # クラスターID
    #   v002 = hv002,  # 世帯ID
    #   v022 = hv022   # 層ID
    # ) %>%
    mutate(
      # 地域タイプ（logical → numeric変換）
      dm_rural = as.numeric(ifelse(hv026 == 3, 1, 0)),
      dm_town = as.numeric(ifelse(hv026 == 2, 1, 0)),
      dm_city = as.numeric(ifelse(hv026 == 1, 1, 0)),
      dm_capital = as.numeric(ifelse(hv026 == 0, 1, 0)),
      
      # 資産五分位（logical → numeric変換）
      dm_poorest = as.numeric(ifelse(hv270 == 1, 1, 0)),
      dm_poorer = as.numeric(ifelse(hv270 == 2, 1, 0)),
      dm_middle = as.numeric(ifelse(hv270 == 3, 1, 0)),
      dm_richer = as.numeric(ifelse(hv270 == 4, 1, 0)),
      dm_richest = as.numeric(ifelse(hv270 == 5, 1, 0)),
      dm_weath_index = hv271/100000
    )
}

# 住居・設備関連変数を作成（修正版）
create_housing_variables <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    mutate(
      # トイレ・調理場所（logical → numeric変換）
      dm_shared_toilet = as.numeric(ifelse(hv238 == 95, 1, 0)),
      dm_cooking_house = as.numeric(ifelse(hv241 == 1, 1, 0)),
      dm_cooking_outdoor = as.numeric(ifelse(hv241 == 3, 1, 0)),
      dm_cooking_separate = as.numeric(ifelse(hv241 == 2, 1, 0)),
      
      # 農地・家畜（logical → numeric変換）
      dm_ag_land_ha = ifelse(hv244 == 0, 0, hv245),
      dm_cattle_own = as.numeric(ifelse(hv246a > 0 & hv246a < 98, 1, 0)),
      dm_goat_own = as.numeric(ifelse(hv246d > 0 & hv246d < 98, 1, 0)),
      dm_sheep_own = as.numeric(ifelse(hv246e > 0 & hv246e < 98, 1, 0)),
      dm_poultry_own = as.numeric(ifelse(hv246g > 0 & hv246g < 98, 1, 0))
    )
}

# 世帯主関連変数を作成（修正版）
create_household_head_variables <- function(data, var_refrigerator = "hv209") {
  data %>%
    mutate(
      dm_refrigerator = as.numeric(ifelse(get(var_refrigerator) == 1, 1, 0)),
      dm_female_headed = as.numeric(ifelse(hv219 == 2, 1, 0)),
      dm_age_of_HH_head = as.numeric(case_when(
        hv220 < 20 ~ 1,
        hv220 >= 20 & hv220 < 30 ~ 2,
        hv220 >= 30 & hv220 < 40 ~ 3,
        hv220 >= 40 & hv220 < 50 ~ 4,
        hv220 >= 50 & hv220 < 60 ~ 5,
        hv220 >= 60 & hv220 < 70 ~ 6,
        hv220 >= 70 & hv220 < 80 ~ 7,
        hv220 >= 80 ~ 8,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ))
    )
}
```

```{r}
set_all_value_labels <- function(data) {

                  "dm_rural", "dm_town", "dm_city", "dm_capital",

                  "dm_poultry_own", "dm_refrigerator", 
                  "dm_female_headed", "dm_age_of_HH_head")

    mutate(across(all_of(label_cols), unclass)) %>%
```

## 8. メインループ

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 7. メイン処理関数
# ============================================================================
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

goAnalysis <- function(year) {
  cat("============================================================================\n")
  cat("ENDES データ統合処理開始:", year, "\n")
  cat("============================================================================\n\n")
  
  # 変数リストを取得
  var_lists <- get_variable_lists()
  
  # 出力ディレクトリを準備
  output_dir <- setup_output_directory(year)
  
  # ============================================================================
  # データ読み込み
  # ============================================================================
  cat("## 1. データファイル読み込み\n")
  
  HRdata <- read_spss(hr_file[[year]]) %>%
    rename_with(~ tolower(.x))
  IRdata <- read_spss(ir_file[[year]]) %>%
    rename_with(~ tolower(.x))

  cat("HRdata レコード数:", nrow(HRdata), "\n")
  cat("IRdata レコード数:", nrow(IRdata), "\n")

  # ============================================================================
  # データ統合
  # ============================================================================
  cat("\n## 3. データセット統合\n")
  
  # 基本データから開始(ラベル保存)
  labels_IR <- save_labels(IRdata, columns = c("caseid"))
  labels_HR <- save_labels(HRdata, columns = c("hhid"))
  # 方法 1: IRdataの結合用ラベル削除
  IRdata_safe <- IRdata %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(c(caseid), ~{
      attr(., "label")  <- NULL
      attr(., "labels") <- NULL
      class(.) <- setdiff(class(.), c("labelled", "haven_labelled"))
      .
    })
  )
  HRdata_safe <- HRdata %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(c(hhid), ~{
      attr(., "label")  <- NULL
      attr(., "labels") <- NULL
      class(.) <- setdiff(class(.), c("labelled", "haven_labelled"))
      .
    })
  )

  IR_HR_data <- merge_HR_IR(HRdata_safe, IRdata_safe)
  # IRdata <- safe_join_datasets(
  #   IRdata_safe, cooking_fuel_safe, by=c("hhid", "caseid"), "IRdata-cooking_fuel")
  # IRdata <- safe_join_datasets(
  #   IRdata, child_count_safe, by=c("hhid", "caseid"), "IRdata-child_count")
  # ラベル復元
  IRdata <- restore_labels(IR_HR_data, labels_IR, columns = c("caseid"))
  IRdata <- restore_labels(IRdata, labels_HR, columns = c("hhid_HR"))
  
  # ============================================================================
  # データ処理
  # ============================================================================
  cat("## 2. データ処理\n")
  
  # 子供の数を計算
  child_count <- calculate_child_count_fixed2(IRdata)
  print("子供の数の分布確認:")
  print(names(child_count))
  
  
  # 調理燃料を処理
  cooking_fuel <- process_cooking_fuel(IRdata)
  print("調理燃料の分布確認:")
  print(names(cooking_fuel))
  
  # データ結合
  IRdata <- safe_join_datasets(
    IRdata, cooking_fuel, by=c("hhid", "caseid"), "IRdata-cooking_fuel")
  IRdata <- safe_join_datasets(
    IRdata, child_count, by=c("hhid", "caseid"), "IRdata-child_count")

  # 調理燃料マッチング確認
  cat("調理燃料マッチング確認:\n")
  print(table(IRdata$dm_cooking_fuel))
  matched_count <- IRdata %>% summarise(n_matched = sum(!is.na(dm_cooking_fuel)))
  print(matched_count)
  

  # 年情報を追加
  IRdata <- IRdata %>% mutate(year = year)

  cat("統合完了 - レコード数:", nrow(IRdata), "\n\n")
  

  # ============================================================================
  # 女性のエンパワーメント指標作成
  # ============================================================================
  cat("## 4. 女性エンパワーメント指標作成\n")
  source(here("Chap15_WE", "WE_EMPW_update.R"), local = environment())

  cat("エンパワーメント指標作成後の確認:\n")
  print(table(WEdata$dm_cooking_fuel))
  print(table(WEdata$dm_children_under12))
  print(table(WEdata$dm_decide_health))

  # ============================================================================
  # 最終変数作成
  # ============================================================================
  cat("\n## 5. 最終変数作成\n")
  
  HRdata <- WEdata
  print(names(WEdata))
  HRdata <- WEdata %>%
    create_demographic_variables() %>%
    create_housing_variables() %>%
    create_household_head_variables() %>%
    mutate(year = year)

  # 必要な変数のみ選択
  vars_to_keep <- HRdata %>%
    dplyr::select(starts_with("dm")) %>%
    names() %>%
    append(c("year", "v001", "v002", "v005", "v022", "caseid", "hhid"))

  HRdata <- HRdata %>% dplyr::select(all_of(vars_to_keep))
  # 
  # # 最終重複チェック
  duplicate_check(HRdata, c("caseid"), "HRdata")
  
  # ============================================================================
  # ラベル設定
  # ============================================================================
  cat("## 6. ラベル設定\n")
  # ラベル設定でエラーが発生した時以下の行を実行
  # diagnose_value_label_issues(HRdata)
  if (year == "2016") {
    cat("2016年の変数ラベルを更新します\n")
    HRdata <- HRdata %>%
      set_all_variable_labels() %>%
      set_all_value_labels_safe()
  } else {
    HRdata <- HRdata %>%
      set_all_variable_labels() %>%
      set_all_value_labels()
    }

  # ============================================================================
  # 保存
  # ============================================================================
  cat("## 7. ファイル保存\n")
  saveRDS(HRdata, paste0(output_dir, "/HRdata-dm.rds"))
  cat("WASHdata保存完了:", year, "\n")
  
  cat("============================================================================\n")
  cat("処理完了:", year, ": データ数", nrow(HRdata), "\n")
  cat("============================================================================\n")
  
  return(HRdata)
}

```

```{r}
for (yr in yearlist) {
  temp[[yr]] <-  goAnalysis(yr)
}
```
